name: urvi-pharmacy
description: Vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript pharmacy management app

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('dist');for(const f of ['index.html','styles.css','app.js'])fs.copyFileSync(f,'dist/'+f);console.log('Static site copied to dist/')"
